items.title: Egg freezing costs up to $20K. Here is how her startup makes it free
items.description:
Egg freezing costs $15-20K in the US, and the people who would benefit most can least afford it. Lauren Makler, CEO of Cofertility, explains egg sharing: freeze and store your eggs free for up to 10 years when you donate some to intended parents.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: Donor banks have no family limit. This founder capped it at three
items.description:
US egg and sperm banks have no limit on how many families one donor can help, because the economics are better without one. Cofertility CEO Lauren Makler explains why they cap it at three families and still run a strong business.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: The Uber lesson this CEO still lives by
items.description:
A lesson Lauren Makler took from her time at Uber: everyone at every level should meet customers. Talking to intended parents taught her that 1 in 3 women over 40 doing IVF are using an egg donor.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: Her whole team builds their own AI tools now
items.description:
Cofertility turned a vibe coding day into a company app store: every employee builds at least one AI tool a teammate uses daily, so ops teams solve their own problems without waiting on the tech roadmap.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: 74% of shoppers take AI's first recommendation
items.description:
74% of the time, shoppers take AI's first recommendation, compared with roughly 50% on Google. First Press host Madeleine explains why there is already so much trust in the AI shortlist.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: Why content written before 2022 is like pure steel
items.description:
Jake Mackler, CEO of Beacon, compares content written before 2022 to pre-atomic 'pure steel': written by humans, for humans. Since 2023, much of the internet is written by AI or for AI, and that makes it harder for AI to learn from.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: AI criticized these brands using their own website
items.description:
Brands are finding that AI says negative things about them, and the source is often their own website. Beacon CEO Jake Mackler shares how a five-year-old internal doc made AI get an insurance product wrong.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: Super-intelligent AI still searches the web like Google
items.description:
AI can solve novel math problems, but how it searches the web is one of its most primitive parts. Beacon CEO Jake Mackler explains what really happens: it searches an index, reads the top results and writes you an answer.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: This brand lost every AI citation overnight
items.description:
A financial services brand built its content to win AI search. Overnight, it lost every citation. Beacon CEO Jake Mackler on why AI search changes every few months and why brands need a long-term plan.

Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel
@firstpress-povc
#startup #founder #business #entrepreneur #podcast

items.title: If AI doesn't recommend it, this CEO won't buy it
items.description:
